integrity: Proof uses exact quotient inverse and polynomial inequalities with standalone SymPy recomputation and rational finite checks; finite enumeration is not used as an infinite proof; no independent audit claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two fixed noise-free leaders, simple unit-weight balanced K_{n,n} with one removed edge and n>=3; not extended to other weights, noise models or arbitrary perturbations; historical priority cannot be guaranteed from bounded source inspection.
title: A six-per-part transition in fault-aware two-leader coherence
